campaign.title: Complete off-diagonal and smooth beta product cell
campaign.frozen_objective: After removing the proved signed diagonal Cauchy section, derive the exact one-count phase-removed singular off-diagonal and smooth product cells and prove their target mixed physical-height, moving-trace, and exact Morse norm, or isolate the first actual-form obstruction.

exit_gates: exact phase-removed singular and smooth product-cell formulas
gamma symbol and profile derivative bounds with external ownership
physical-center, top-diagonal, radial-ridge, and far-tail partition
moving physical faces and affine switches
both saddle signs and exact normalized Morse entry/exit remainder
beta connector and common artificial ownership
target hybrid remainder norm or sharp actual-form obstruction
conductor decision before invoking the closed coefficient sum

superseded_artifacts.reason: The run disclosed proof-graph exposure and is retained only as a contaminated independent rederivation, not as the statement-only gate.

closing_assessment.main_result: The exact modulated off-diagonal and smooth product cell has the target mixed norm on both signed large-alpha saddle/entry/exit cells. Composed with the signed diagonal and coefficient sum, the complete large-alpha beta package is O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)); bounded-alpha and double-bounded cells remain open.
